newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Tractebel to further reduce pay-out ratio.
newsitem.headline: Tractebel to further reduce pay-out ratio.

text.p: Belgian utility holding company Tractebel SA told shareholders on Wednesday it planned to further reduce its dividend pay-out ratio to 50 percent of consolidated net earnings.

"The board's policy is to gradually reduce pay-outs to 50 percent. We want to spend half of our profit on investments which will allow us to maintain our return on equity," chief executive officer Philippe Bodson told the annual meeting.
The dividend on 1996 earnings was increased by 15 francs to 385 francs net per share for a pay-out ratio of 59 percent.
The group has regularly shaved the ratio. It was 74 percent on 1990 earnings.
Tractebel is a unit of Belgian holding company Societe Generale de Belgique SA (SGB), itself a unit of French Compagnie de Suez.
